backrooms.description: A wanderer who will survive face to face with unknown creatures of the Backrooms. Build your base, craft your very own weapons and keep yourself alive! Search for an exit while you feel the fear to the core! Are you ready? Because Backrooms: The Yellow Dream is going to push your limits!

notes.text: "I wish you didn't just suck filthy ass....but you do" - Sark
